complete_examples.text: To show the difference between unit base plate and longitudinal connected base plate, the static mapping displacement of base plate is calculated, as shown in Fig. 17.
Comparing to the longitudinal connected base plate, the mapping displacement and dynamic behavior of the unit base plate is more sensitive to the adverse combination of wavelength and amplitude.
